card.text: The smaller star of the ROXs 42B pair, 11 au from its partner on a 31-year orbit seen edge-on.

introduction.text: ROXs 42B B circles its partner every 31 years. Seen almost exactly edge-on, it swings from one side of the star to the other.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: A blackbody at the star's published temperature. No surface picture exists.
